name: agent-tracing-telemetry
context: Production agent systems that require full observability into agent behavior — not just input/output pairs but the full reasoning trace, tool calls, intermediate decisions, and state transitions. Tracing instruments the agent at the instrumentation layer to emit structured spans for every step (reasoning, tool call, memory access, plan update), enabling distributed tracing, latency analysis, cost attribution, and failure diagnosis. Unlike decision-log (post-hoc audit of actions), tracing is real-time instrumentation that feeds into observability platforms.
benefits: Full end-to-end trace enables root-cause analysis of failures
Per-step latency and cost attribution enables cost optimization
Distributed tracing-style spans enable correlation across agent components
tradeoffs: Instrumentation adds overhead to every agent step
Trace storage and processing can be expensive at scale
Requires defining a trace schema that covers all agent operations
Tool outputs can be very large — trace volume management is critical
use_cases: Production monitoring of customer-facing agent systems
Cost attribution across agents, tools, and users in an enterprise deployment
Debugging long-running agent failures in production
Compliance auditing of agent decisions in regulated industries
avoid_when: High-volume inference where tracing overhead is prohibitive
anti_patterns: Tracing every token — too much noise
No trace sampling strategy (storing every trace in production)
Tracing without a schema — unstructured spans are hard to query
design_principles: Emit spans for every agent step with structured attributes
Propagate trace context across sub-agent boundaries
Sample traces intelligently — 100% at low volume, sampled at high volume
best_practices: Define a span naming convention and stick to it across the codebase
Include cost, latency, token count, and decision reason as standard span attributes
Integrate trace storage with a queryable backend for dashboarding
references: OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing for LLM Applications, 2024 — https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/
